traits.leaf_habit.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Gymnosperms (DELTA, 2008 onwards, version of 5 August 2019), Ginkgoaceae: deciduous trees to 30 m; leaves broad, long-stalked and fan-shaped, their many veins forking in pairs, set spirally on long shoots and in clusters on spur shoots that leaf out year after year; dioecious; the ovules are not in cones but in pairs at the ends of stalks on the spur shoots.
